mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_RECIPE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO RECIPE(RECIPE_ID, AUTHOR_ID, SOURCE_TYPE, EXTERNAL_KEY, TITLE, SUMMARY, THUMBNAIL_URL, COOK_MINUTES, DIFFICULTY, SERVINGS, STATUS, OTHER_INGREDIENT, PUBLISHED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{authorId}, 'MEMBER', 'MEMBER_' || #{recipeId}, #{title}, #{summary, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{thumbnailUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cookMinutes, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{difficulty, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{servings, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 0, #{otherIngredient, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select:
SELECT R.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, R.AUTHOR_ID AS authorId, NVL(M.NAME, '회원') AS authorName, R.SOURCE_TYPE AS sourceType, R.TITLE AS title, R.SUMMARY AS summary, R.THUMBNAIL_URL AS thumbnailUrl, R.COOK_MINUTES AS cookMinutes, R.DIFFICULTY AS difficulty, R.SERVINGS AS servings, R.STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, NVL(L.likeCount, 0) AS likeCount, NVL(B.bookmarkCount, 0) AS bookmarkCount, NVL(V.reviewCount, 0) AS reviewCount FROM RECIPE R LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER M ON R.AUTHOR_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT RECIPE_ID, COUNT(*) AS likeCount FROM RECIPE_LIKE GROUP BY RECIPE_ID ) L ON R.RECIPE_ID = L.RECIPE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT RECIPE_ID, COUNT(*) AS bookmarkCount FROM RECIPE_BOOKMARK GROUP BY RECIPE_ID ) B ON R.RECIPE_ID = B.RECIPE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT RECIPE_ID, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM RECIPE_REVIEW WHERE STATUS = 0 GROUP BY RECIPE_ID ) V ON R.RECIPE_ID = V.RECIPE_ID
R.SOURCE_TYPE = 'MEMBER' AND R.STATUS = 0 AND R.DELETED_AT IS NULL
AND
AND R.RECIPE_ID IN ( SELECT RECIPE_ID FROM RECIPE_CATEGORY WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} )
AND R.AUTHOR_ID = #{authorId}
ORDER BY R.RECIPE_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT R.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, R.AUTHOR_ID AS authorId, NVL(M.NAME, '회원') AS authorName, R.SOURCE_TYPE AS sourceType, R.EXTERNAL_KEY AS externalKey, R.TITLE AS title, R.SUMMARY AS summary, R.THUMBNAIL_URL AS thumbnailUrl, R.COOK_MINUTES AS cookMinutes, R.DIFFICULTY AS difficulty, R.SERVINGS AS servings, R.STATUS AS status, R.BLIND_REASON AS blindReason, R.OTHER_INGREDIENT AS otherIngredient, TO_CHAR(R.PUBLISHED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS publishedAt, TO_CHAR(R.DELETED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS deletedAt, TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(R.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt, NVL(L.likeCount, 0) AS likeCount, NVL(B.bookmarkCount, 0) AS bookmarkCount, NVL(V.reviewCount, 0) AS reviewCount FROM RECIPE R LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER M ON R.AUTHOR_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT RECIPE_ID, COUNT(*) AS likeCount FROM RECIPE_LIKE GROUP BY RECIPE_ID ) L ON R.RECIPE_ID = L.RECIPE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT RECIPE_ID, COUNT(*) AS bookmarkCount FROM RECIPE_BOOKMARK GROUP BY RECIPE_ID ) B ON R.RECIPE_ID = B.RECIPE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT RECIPE_ID, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM RECIPE_REVIEW WHERE STATUS = 0 GROUP BY RECIPE_ID ) V ON R.RECIPE_ID = V.RECIPE_ID WHERE R.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} AND R.SOURCE_TYPE = 'MEMBER' AND R.STATUS = 0 AND R.DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE RECIPE SET TITLE = #{title}, SUMMARY = #{summary, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, THUMBNAIL_URL = #{thumbnailUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COOK_MINUTES = #{cookMinutes, jdbcType=INTEGER}, DIFFICULTY = #{difficulty, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SERVINGS = #{servings, jdbcType=INTEGER}, OTHER_INGREDIENT = #{otherIngredient, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} AND AUTHOR_ID = #{authorId} AND SOURCE_TYPE = 'MEMBER' AND STATUS = 0 AND DELETED_AT IS NULL

UPDATE RECIPE SET STATUS = 2, DELETED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} AND AUTHOR_ID = #{authorId} AND SOURCE_TYPE = 'MEMBER' AND STATUS = 0 AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE RECIPE SET STATUS = 1, BLIND_REASON = #{blindReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} AND SOURCE_TYPE = 'MEMBER' AND STATUS = 0 AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, DESCRIPTION AS description, ACTIVE_YN AS activeYn, SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt FROM CATEGORY WHERE ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, CATEGORY_ID

SELECT TAG_ID AS tagId, TAG_NAME AS tagName, TAG_GROUP AS tagGroup, ACTIVE_YN AS activeYn, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt FROM TAG WHERE ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY TAG_GROUP, TAG_ID

SELECT INGREDIENT_ID AS ingredientId, INGREDIENT_NAME AS ingredientName, INGREDIENT_TYPE AS ingredientType, DEFAULT_UNIT AS defaultUnit, ACTIVE_YN AS activeYn, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt FROM INGREDIENT
ACTIVE_YN = 'Y'
AND INSTR(INGREDIENT_NAME, #{kwd}) > 0
AND INGREDIENT_TYPE = #{ingredientType}
ORDER BY INGREDIENT_NAME, INGREDIENT_ID

SELECT R.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, R.INGREDIENT_ID AS ingredientId, I.INGREDIENT_NAME AS ingredientName, R.AMOUNT AS amount, R.UNIT AS unit, R.REQUIRED_YN AS requiredYn, R.SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, R.NOTE AS note FROM RECIPE_INGREDIENT R JOIN INGREDIENT I ON R.INGREDIENT_ID = I.INGREDIENT_ID WHERE R.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} ORDER BY R.SORT_ORDER, R.INGREDIENT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RECIPE_INGREDIENT(RECIPE_ID, INGREDIENT_ID, AMOUNT, UNIT, REQUIRED_YN, SORT_ORDER, NOTE) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{ingredientId}, #{amount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{unit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requiredYn}, #{sortOrder}, #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT STEP_ID AS stepId, RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, STEP_NO AS stepNo, DESCRIPTION AS description, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, TIMER_SECONDS AS timerSeconds FROM RECIPE_STEP WHERE RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} ORDER BY STEP_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RECIPE_STEP(STEP_ID, RECIPE_ID, STEP_NO, DESCRIPTION, IMAGE_URL, TIMER_SECONDS) VALUES (SEQ_RECIPE_STEP.NEXTVAL, #{recipeId}, #{stepNo}, #{description}, #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{timerSeconds, jdbcType=INTEGER})

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPE_BOOKMARK WHERE RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT R.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, R.TITLE AS title FROM RECIPE R LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER M ON R.AUTHOR_ID = M.MEMBER_ID
R.RECIPE_ID > #{recipeId} AND R.SOURCE_TYPE = 'MEMBER' AND R.STATUS = 0 AND R.DELETED_AT IS NULL
AND
AND R.RECIPE_ID IN ( SELECT RECIPE_ID FROM RECIPE_CATEGORY WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} )
ORDER BY R.RECIPE_ID ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT R.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, R.TITLE AS title FROM RECIPE R LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER M ON R.AUTHOR_ID = M.MEMBER_ID
R.RECIPE_ID < #{recipeId} AND R.SOURCE_TYPE = 'MEMBER' AND R.STATUS = 0 AND R.DELETED_AT IS NULL
